theme: Dark Theme Dominant (Navy Deep #000c3d) with strategic light sections (#F2F2F2) for contrast.

typography.font_setup_instructions: Import Onest (weights 300, 400, 700, 900) and Source Serif 4 from Google Fonts. Configure Tailwind to use Onest as sans and Source Serif 4 as serif.

hierarchy.H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-sans font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.H2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-sans font-bold tracking-tight
hierarchy.Body: text-base sm:text-lg font-sans font-light leading-relaxed text-gray-300
hierarchy.Overline: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#A8ECF2]

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(60, 203, 218, 0.2) for subtle division. Use sharp edges or max rounded-md for premium feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on dark backgrounds to add tactile feel and prevent flat digital look.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp rectangles. Primary CTA: bg-[#3CCBDA] text-[#000c3d] hover:bg-[#A8ECF2] transition-colors. Secondary CTA: border border-[#3CCBDA] text-[#3CCBDA] hover:bg-[#3CCBDA]/10.

layouts.hero: min-h-screen relative flex items-center pt-24 pb-12. Content layered over full-bleed absolute image with heavy dark overlay (bg-[#000c3d]/60 to bg-[#001871]/40 mix-blend-multiply).
layouts.method_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-24 items-start py-24
layouts.stats_band: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 py-16 border-y border-white/10
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for main sections. gap-8 to gap-16 between structural blocks.

components.Navbar: Sticky top-0 z-50. Glassmorphism background. Includes Logo (text based or placeholder), Center Links, and Right section with ES/EN toggle + WhatsApp CTA.
components.Hero: Kinetic text reveal (line by line) using framer-motion. H1 must be bold, establishing health systems authority.
components.MarqueeRibbon: react-fast-marquee. Thin band (py-4), bg-[#303AB2] or dark navy, text-[#A8ECF2]. Items: ESTRUCTURAR • ALINEAR • EJECUTAR • CONSOLIDAR. Slow continuous scroll.
components.MethodCard: Number in Source Serif 4 (e.g., '01'). Title in Onest. Description in Onest light. Minimalist, high negative space.
components.ServiceCard: Flat solid or subtle glass. Title, short description, 'Descubrir ->' link to WhatsApp.
components.AudiencePills: Flex wrap container. Pills with border border-white/20 rounded-full px-6 py-3 text-sm hover:border-[#3CCBDA] transition-colors.
components.Timeline: Vertical line on left side. Nodes for 2021, 2022-23, Hoy. Content on right of the line.
components.FinalCTA: Massive typography '¿Listos para estructurar el futuro?'. Centralized layout. Prominent WhatsApp button (+595 971 175353).
components.LanguageToggle: Simple 'ES / EN' button in navbar switching state (visual only if logic isn't wired).

motion.scrolling: Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion.reveals: Framer-motion for scroll-triggered entrance (y: 30, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: 'easeOut'). Stagger children in grids.
motion.hero_kinetic: Framer-motion stagger text reveal. Split text into lines, overflow hidden on wrapper, animate y from 100% to 0%.
motion.hover_states: Subtle transform translate-y-[-2px] on cards. Arrow icon sliding right (translate-x-1) on 'Descubrir' links.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #000c3d meets APCA. Use #A8ECF2 for small accents to maintain readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, toggles, links) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-cta-hero').
accessibility.aria: Add aria-label to WhatsApp buttons and Language toggle.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke width thin (1.5 or 1.25) for elegant editorial look.
media.images: Use full width, object-cover. Ensure max-h-[80vh] for mobile where applicable, except full-screen hero.

3d_libraries_and_steps.recommendation: Use framer-motion for parallax and elegant reveals. Avoid heavy 3D unless strictly necessary to maintain the 'sober' tone. A subtle mouse-follow parallax on the hero background image is recommended using framer-motion useScroll/useTransform.

hero_background.description: Deep blue background with subtle curved lines. Perfect for an elegant, abstract hero section.

doctor_lab.description: Modern laboratory microscope. Represents the scientific/clinical background of the CEO.

doctor_portrait.description: Professional standing in blue light. Stand-in for Dra. Horvath's dark-blue portrait.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
Setup Tailwind config with the brand colors (#001871, #000c3d, #3CCBDA, #A8ECF2, #303AB2, #FF94CA).
Configure Google Fonts: Onest and Source Serif 4 in the main HTML.
Build the bilingual toggle state (can be a simple React state 'es'/'en' that changes text in a dictionary object).
Implement the sticky Navbar with glassmorphism.
Implement the Hero section with Framer Motion kinetic text reveal.
Implement the react-fast-marquee component directly below the hero.
Build the PRECEDENT™ method section with large Source Serif 4 numbers.
Ensure all WhatsApp buttons link to 'https://wa.me/595971175353'.
Apply 'dark' theme stylings (text-white against #000c3d background) globally.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the specified colors and typography strictly.
Do not use dark colors as gradients (keep them solid or with a noise overlay).
Create depth through layered design elements and subtle borders (1px solid #3CCBDA/20).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Animate specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect left-alignment for dense text.
Use pill-shaped buttons for primary CTAs.
DO NOT use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Implement micro-animations on hover states and entrance scroll reveals.
Use generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to avoid cramped, cheap looks.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Maintain high contrast ratios for text on dark backgrounds.
Ensure the language toggle is clearly visible and accessible.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the navbar or overlays where content scrolls underneath.
Keep typography scale fluid and responsive (clamp or tailwind sm/md/lg classes).
